Container.Name: ps5-rom-sync
Container.Overview: Copies your ROM library to a jailbroken PS5 over FTP, sorted into the folders RetroArch and Porpoise (GameCube/Wii) read from. Hit + to add a sync per system. Works with a plain ROM folder or with RomM: point the ROMs path at RomM's library folder, enter your RomM address in the web page, and pick games by RomM platform or collection.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Where settings and sync jobs are saved.

Config.Name: ROMs
Config.Description: Your ROM library. If you use RomM, set this to the same folder RomM has mounted at /romm/library. Read-only is fine.

Config.Name: PS5 IP address
Config.Description: Optional. Pre-fills the PS5 address; you can also set it in the web page.

Config.Name: PS5 FTP port
Config.Description: 2121 for ftpsrv, 1337 for etaHEN's built-in FTP.

Config.Name: RomM address
Config.Description: Optional, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8080. Can also be set in the web page.

Config.Name: RomM API token
Config.Description: Optional. Use instead of user and password if your RomM version supports API tokens.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Time zone for the activity log.
